title: Member Services Eligibility Guide: Enrolling a Service Account in Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)
content:
# Enrollment Eligibility — Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)

## Rule of eligibility

Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) is offered only on a service account whose rate schedule is marked eligible for Budget Billing and is among the plan's eligible rate schedules, held by a member whose member type is among the plan's eligible member types. The service account must be active and its past-due amount at most the plan's largest past-due amount allowed at enrollment. The location must have been in the member's name for the plan's required number of full calendar months, and the enrollment month must be one of the plan's accepted enrollment months. Because no plan may coexist with PrePay Power or with an active payment arrangement on the account, an account on PrePay Power or with an active payment arrangement cannot enroll. Where the plan requires automatic bank draft the account must be on automatic bank draft. Where the plan requires the member's confirmation of the terms, the plan is enrolled only on the member's confirmation of the terms: a Budget Billing request of the enrollment type in member-confirmed status. The anniversary month is the month of the first budget bill. Enrollment is taken through one of the plan's enrollment channels and bills the plan's enrollment fee where it is above zero.

The plan figures this rule reads — eligible rate schedules, eligible member types, required full calendar months, largest past-due amount, accepted enrollment months, the automatic bank draft and confirmation requirements, the channels and the fee — are those of the plan the account would enroll in.

## Eligibility checklist

Every line must hold; "offered only" makes the list complete, so an account that fails any line is not enrolled.

| Condition | What must be shown | Where it is shown |
|---|---|---|
| Rate schedule | Marked eligible for Budget Billing, and on the plan's list | The service account's rate schedule |
| Member type | On the plan's list | The member's record |
| Account status | Active | The service account record |
| Past due | At most the plan's largest past-due amount at enrollment | The service account balance |
| Service in the member's name | At least the plan's required full calendar months | The service account history at the location |
| Enrollment month | One of the plan's accepted months | The calendar month of enrollment |
| PrePay Power | Not on PrePay Power | The account's PrePay Power records |
| Payment arrangement | No active payment arrangement | The account's payment arrangement records |
| Automatic bank draft | On draft, where the plan requires it | The account's payment setup |
| Member's confirmation | A Budget Billing enrollment request in member-confirmed status, where the plan requires it | The member's Budget Billing requests |

The account status and past-due amount are system-record conditions on the service account being enrolled; a member's statement that the account is current does not replace them.

## Points of judgement

**Full calendar months.** Only complete calendar months count. *Hypothetical:* service at a location has been in the member's name since the 14th of March. March is a partial month and does not count; the first full calendar month is April. On a plan requiring 12 full calendar months, the requirement is met once April through the following March have all been completed, and is not met while only April through February have.

**Past-due amount.** Every plan allows $0.00, so a past-due amount of one cent or more fails the condition, and $0.00 meets it.

**Anniversary month.** The anniversary month is set by the first budget bill, not by the day the member called. *Hypothetical:* a member enrolls in October and the first budget bill is in November; the anniversary month is November.

**Fee.** A fee is billed only where the plan's enrollment fee is above zero.

## Hypothetical outcomes

| Hypothetical account | Outcome under this rule |
|---|---|
| All lines met, the member has confirmed the terms | May be enrolled |
| All lines met except an active payment arrangement on the account | Cannot enroll |
| All lines met except that the account runs on PrePay Power | Cannot enroll |
| All lines met, but no member-confirmed enrollment request exists | Not enrolled |
| Account inactive | Cannot enroll |
